title: Wada Darvesh
body:
Wada Darvesh
Ya fatema zehra - 5
<<MINI>>
Kiya hai wada jo zehra se wo nibhana hai - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ke jaan jaye to jaaye - 2 ke ghar jale to jale
<<MINI>>
Kiya hai wada jo zehra se wo nibhana hai - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ham apne baccho ko lekar chalenge sholo per - 2
Chalenge sholo per
Zamana aag ke maatam se ab jale to jale
2. In aansuo ki kharidar hai hussain ki maa - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai hussain ki maa
Hamare rone pe duniya agar hase to hase
3. Juloos ruk nahi sakta kisi bhi keemat per - 2
Kisi bhi keemat per
<<DIVIDER>>
Hamari saaso ka chahe safar ruke to ruke
4. Misaal hur ki hai maujood har bashar ke liye - 2
Har bashar ke liye
Jo hurmala ke qabile me ab rahe to rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kisi yazeed ke aage wo jhuk nahi sakta - 2
jhuk nahi sakta
Hussainiyat ki baqa me ye sar kate to kate
6. Kahi na jaayenge maula ko chhodkar ansaar - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Chhodkar ansaar
Charage khayma jale to jale buje to buje
7. Lahad ki zahra pe ummul baneen ne ki thi dua - 2
Bas yahi thi dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Tumhara ghar na lute mera ghar lute to lute
8. Dua ye karti thi zaynab hussain bach jaaye - 2
Hussain bach jaaye
Gale pe beto ke mere churi phire to phire
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Karenge sajda ye aansu hussain ke dar per - 2
Hussain ke dar per
Kisi ko meer takallum bura lage to lage
